chunks: Say: "I call on my Lord alone and I do not associate any one with Him."
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to call upon God alone without associating partners with Him?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Jinn, this verse serves as the Prophet's (peace be upon him) definitive response to the jinn who heard the Quran and believed, distinguishing his pure monotheism from the polytheistic practices of pre-Islamic Arabia. Shia scholarship highlights this as a model of *Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah* (Oneness in Worship), emphasizing that all acts of devotion, including supplication, must be directed exclusively to Allah without intermediaries or partners.
